meta.scene: Brass polished, wick trimmed, the way his father taught him.
On the horizon, the storm wall turns black.
He lights the lamp. The beam sweeps out across the waves.
The power fails. A ship’s horn, somewhere in the dark.
He turns the lens by hand.
The ship sees the light. It turns away from the rocks.
Dawn, in D major. He hands the keys to the machine.
